lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with a higher concentration of smaller spots located anteriorly near the head region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like alignment across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, marked by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal surface to a darker shadow gradient on the ventral side of the ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, lower-contrast spots relative to the larger constellations on the main body flank.
